component.name: PvZ2 Gardendless
component.summary: Play Gardendless and manage game profiles

description.p: Gardendless includes the game, GP-Next overlay, and a launcher for separate save profiles and game preferences.
The launcher provides local save and keybind editors, automatic backups before edits, and audio runtime checks.
Introduces the launcher, profile save and keybind editors, GP-Next launch controls, and configurable Linux audio presets.
